Conservative English case-insensitive whole-word lexical gate with prefix families using \w*: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Extra refusals cover truth, physical validity (space or hyphen), diagnos* and patient*. It is incomplete and refuses negations too.

Unavailable text additionally refuses supported, replicated, suggestive and significan*. Any unavailable kind/result citation requires unavailable status, including mixed support. Both evidence kind and result are checked for review, approv, comput, numer, agreement, truth, physical and clinic.
Weighted fits use normalized weights and centered weighted R-squared; residual standard error is unweighted. A frozen single-pass exclusion cannot establish biological validity.
